html:
G'oya

Bank ko'chirmasidan buxgalteriya yozuvlarini ayirsak, bankdagi ortiqcha to'lovlar qoladi. Teskarisi buxgalteriyadagi ortiqchalarni beradi. Ikkala natijani yorliq bilan UNION ALL qilamiz. Nozik joyi takrorlar: oddiy EXCEPT to'plam bilan ishlaydi va "nechta" degan savolni bilmaydi.

Yechim

PostgreSQL'da buning uchun tayyor amal bor, EXCEPT ALL. U har bir qatorni necha marta uchraganini hisobga oladi: bankda 2 ta, buxgalteriyada 1 ta bo'lsa, 1 ta qoladi.

Faqat PostgreSQLSELECT 'bank' AS source, paid_on, amount
FROM (
  SELECT paid_on, amount FROM bank_payments
  EXCEPT ALL
  SELECT paid_on, amount FROM ledger_entries
) b
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ledger', paid_on, amount
FROM (
  SELECT paid_on, amount FROM ledger_entries
  EXCEPT ALL
  SELECT paid_on, amount FROM bank_payments
) l

SQLite'da EXCEPT ALL yo'q. Uning o'rniga bir xil to'lovlarni raqamlab chiqamiz: 1-mart, 150 000 dan bankda 1 va 2-raqamli, buxgalteriyada faqat 1-raqamli. Raqam qo'shilgach qatorlar takrorlanmaydi va oddiy EXCEPT yetadi: (2024-03-01, 150000, 2) ning jufti yo'q.

WITH b AS (
  SELECT paid_on, amount,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY paid_on, amount ORDER BY id) AS rn
  FROM bank_payments
),
l AS (
  SELECT paid_on, amount,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY paid_on, amount ORDER BY id) AS rn
  FROM ledger_entries
)
SELECT 'bank' AS source, paid_on, amount
FROM (SELECT paid_on, amount, rn FROM b EXCEPT SELECT paid_on, amount, rn FROM l) x
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ledger', paid_on, amount
FROM (SELECT paid_on, amount, rn FROM l EXCEPT SELECT paid_on, amount, rn FROM b) y

Bu so'rov ikkala bazada ishlaydi.

Tuzoqlar

Oddiy EXCEPT namunadagi ikkinchi 150 000 ni yo'qotadi: bu summa buxgalteriyada bor, demak to'plamlar nuqtai nazaridan hammasi joyida.

Noto'g'riSELECT 'bank' AS source, paid_on, amount
FROM (
  SELECT paid_on, amount FROM bank_payments
  EXCEPT
  SELECT paid_on, amount FROM ledger_entries
) b
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ledger', paid_on, amount
FROM (
  SELECT paid_on, amount FROM ledger_entries
  EXCEPT
  SELECT paid_on, amount FROM bank_payments
) l

NOT EXISTS ham xuddi shu xatoga tushadi: jufti bitta bo'lsa ham, ikkala bank to'lovi "mos" deb hisoblanadi.

Oxiridagi birlashtirish UNION ALL bo'lishi shart. UNION bankda uch marta takrorlangan to'lovning mos kelmagan ikki nusxasini bittaga aylantiradi.

Dialektlar farqi

INTERSECT ALL va EXCEPT ALL faqat PostgreSQL'da. SQLite ularni sintaksis xatosi deb qaytaradi.
